result.title: Trust but Verify: Designing Region-Inhomogeneous Forward Dynamics for Discrete Diffusion
result.comment: Accepted to 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: AI for Stochastic Dynamics. 10 pages
result.summary: Continuous diffusion treats the forward process as a design space; discrete language diffusion often uses absorbing corruption, leaving context fully trusted throughout generation. This makes trust binary: corrupted context is copied as ground truth, propagating errors into generated spans. We reopen this design space by combining absorbing and uniform-mixing kernels with region-dependent rates. Missing positions follow absorbing dynamics, while context undergoes low-rate random substitution, exposing the model to observed but uncertain tokens during training. At inference, a heuristic sampler re-injects noise into suspicious context under an annealed intensity and freezes context updates late in the trajectory. An 8,000-step finetune of a pretrained 170M-parameter masked diffusion model takes under five hours on a 6 GB laptop GPU. The base model assigns roughly 50% probability to observed tokens even when they are uniform-random garbage. For uniform-random corruption, finetuning detects corrupted context with 0.96 recall and 0.91 precision, improves infill token-F1 by 3.8 points at 10% corruption and 6.4 points at 20%, and removes the accuracy dip next to corruptions. Clean conditioning shows no measurable regression, with a false-edit rate below 0.4%. Gains for plausible corruptions are weaker: about 0.5 F1 points at 10% corruption, without statistical significance. Our results suggest that detectability and damage depend jointly on departure from the data conditional: nearby noise is hard to detect and semantically mild, while distant noise is conspicuous and destructive. We interpret absorbing diffusion as the infinite-contrast limit of a trust axis, analogous to the signal-to-noise gap between known and unknown regions in diffusion inpainting. In our setting of a 170M model and a single text domain, intermediate trust is reached by changing forward dynamics rather than architecture.

AI.brief_summary: 研究离散扩散的前向动力学设计：混合 absorbing 与 uniform-mixing 核并按区域设定加噪速率，使模型在训练中接触带不确定性的上下文，并在推理时对可疑上下文重注入退火噪声、在轨迹后段冻结上下文更新，以 170M 掩码扩散模型微调验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「信任轴」及对上下文 token 是否可信的检测与降权，可能对应 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与 latent 状态可信度估计；推理期噪声再注入与后段冻结更新的调度，可供核查 LOOK/STOP 的证据取舍与停止决策借鉴，尽管原文为纯文本离散扩散、未涉及多模态。
